# TopologyAwareSemanticRouting

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A routing mechanism in topology-centric computing that directs semantic queries along graph edges based on feature similarity and connectivity. Optimizes data flow in TCC architectures by leveraging graph topology to reduce latency in cross-linguistic semantic retrieval.
